credit.notes: Block immediately via any channel: Website 'block or reissue your credit card using your mobile number'; Helpline +91 22 6232 7777; RBL MyCard App > My Account > Settings > Profile settings > Report Dispute or Fraud > Fraud > BLOCK & REPLACE/BLOCK CARD; SMS 'BLKRBL <last two digits of card>' to +91 9223366333 from registered mobile (block + replacement); WhatsApp 'Hi RBL' to 84335 98888 > Credit Card Services > Switch-off Card Transaction; Chatbot RBL Cares > Menu > Insta Services > Block and Reissue Credit Card.

debit.notes: Block immediately via any channel: Website 'block your debit card using your CIF number'; Helpline +91 22 6232 7777; SMS to 9223366333 from registered mobile - Temporary Block: 'TBLOCK <last four digits of card> <Customer ID>' / Permanent Block: 'BLOCK <last four digits of card> <Customer ID>'; RBL MyBank app > Manage Your Cards > Block/Unblock Card > OTP; NetBanking > Requests > Block Debit Card; WhatsApp 'Hi RBL' to 84335 98888 > Banking Services.
